name: BreastCancerFixtureCodes
title: Breast cancer fixture contract codes
description: Track-local codes for synthetic input assertions. Clinical stage concepts express supplied clinical assessments, not stage inference from size. These are not official AJCC, SNOMED CT, or mCODE terminology mappings.

concept.definition: Explicit synthetic assertion of an invasive primary breast carcinoma; not DCIS alone.
Pretreatment clinical primary-tumor category, explicitly asserted for the indexed cancer.
Pretreatment clinical regional-node category, explicitly asserted for the indexed cancer.
Clinical distant-metastasis category, explicitly asserted for the indexed cancer.
Supplied clinical category: primary tumor greater than 5 mm and no greater than 10 mm.
Supplied clinical category: primary tumor greater than 10 mm and no greater than 20 mm.
Supplied clinical category: no regional lymph-node metastases.
Supplied clinical category: regional-node-positive disease in clinical N1 category.
Explicit clinical assessment documents no distant metastasis; never inferred from an absent record.
Explicit clinical assessment documents distant metastasis.
Unresolved qualitative result. This is neither a negative nor a positive receptor interpretation.
Supplied clinical category: microinvasion no greater than 1 mm.
Supplied clinical category: tumor greater than 1 mm and no greater than 5 mm.
Supplied clinical category: tumor greater than 20 mm and no greater than 50 mm.
Supplied clinical category: tumor greater than 50 mm.
Supplied clinical category: tumor with direct extension to chest wall and/or skin under clinical staging rules; size alone does not establish T4.
Supplied clinical category: regional-node-positive disease in clinical N2 category.
Supplied clinical category: regional-node-positive disease in clinical N3 category.
